biophysical_burden.boundary: Observed increase in low-oxygen open-ocean area; coastal site counts are not added.

human_economic_burden.boundary: Exposed ocean-service livelihood scope, not harm attributed specifically to oxygen loss.

extent.geographic_scope: global open ocean, estuaries and other coastal water bodies

excluded_from_scoring: open-ocean area added to coastal area

transformations.formula: Normalize the source-reported 4.5 million km2 expansion without adding coastal site counts.
Normalize a source-reported lower bound on ocean-dependent livelihoods without treating exposure as realized deoxygenation loss.
Use the source-declared global open-ocean scope.

receipts.uncertainty: Coastal monitoring is geographically uneven and underreporting is likely, especially in the tropics. Site inventories do not provide consistent area, duration, severity or observation cadence and cannot be summed into a global hypoxic area.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: IOC-UNESCO quantifies accumulated low-oxygen open-ocean area expansion, ocean-service livelihood exposure, multi-decade persistence and global extent.
higher_priority_failures: No complete current global dissolved-oxygen panel supplies magnitude plus threshold or momentum under a single observation method.
Coastal and open-ocean measurements remain separate, so the assessment is impact fallback rather than current data.

biophysical_burden.boundary: Population exposure above WHO guideline levels; pollutant-specific concentrations remain separate.

human_economic_burden.boundary: Ambient-only mortality; household-air-pollution deaths are not added.

extent.geographic_scope: global population and WHO member reporting context

transformations.formula: Normalize the source-reported global population share above WHO air-quality guideline levels.
Normalize ambient-air mortality without adding overlapping household exposure.
Use the WHO global population aggregation.

receipts.uncertainty: WHO comparative-risk estimates combine modeled population exposure, integrated exposure-response functions, background disease burden and population data. Ambient and household exposure overlap; global totals are statistically adjusted to avoid double counting.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: WHO quantifies global guideline exceedance exposure, ambient-air attributable mortality, repeated multi-year burden and worldwide scope.
higher_priority_failures: The source does not provide a complete 20-year annual global exceedance-day panel by pollutant.
Population exposure and comparative-risk mortality are assessment evidence rather than a current concentration series.

biophysical_burden.boundary: Observed mangrove subset; no emissions factor is applied to unmeasured tidal wetlands.

excluded_from_scoring: future restoration targets and restorable area
raw OBIS occurrence counts as habitat-area evidence

transformations.formula: Use the observed mangrove carbon-stock reduction as a bounded subset of tidal-wetland carbon reversal.
Normalize the midpoint of the source damage range while retaining both bounds.
Use the 1996-2020 habitat and stock-change interval.
Divide mangrove countries by the source denominator.

receipts.uncertainty: Historical baselines, habitat definitions, remote-sensing classification, unmapped small patches, natural gains and losses, carbon-stock methods, service valuation and proximity-based population exposure affect estimates. Proximity does not establish individual dependence.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: UNEP quantifies observed mangrove carbon-stock reduction, associated annual damage, multi-decade persistence and global country extent as a tidal-wetland subset.
higher_priority_failures: No current annual global tidal-wetland greenhouse-gas balance spans all habitat classes.
Mangrove, seagrass and salt-marsh stocks are not added across incompatible methods.
